name: SabaiDee
description: SabaiDee makes broad-spectrum CBD oils and related wellness products from organically grown hemp, with public lab tests, sold direct to consumers through its own store.

evidence.summary: SabaiDee's own affiliate page offers a 30% commission from every online sale with a 30-day cookie and a bonus program, and states verbatim that it offers affiliates 'uncapped earning potential'. Enrollment runs through Refersion (sabaidee.refersion.com); the program is described as invite-only.
The program page's FAQ directs affiliate questions to hello@getsabaidee.com.
The page states its products are broad-spectrum CBD created using organic hemp, with public lab tests and premium-quality positioning.

opportunity.title: SabaiDee affiliate program via Refersion - 30% commission, uncapped earning potential stated on the brand's own program page

reasons.niche_fit: CBD oil sits squarely in the wellness niche, with strong educational and routine-based content angles for health creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own program page is written for affiliates and influencers, offering exclusive banners, a promo code and sales-tracking tools.
reasons.compensation: A 30% base commission - among the highest published in CBD - plus a bonus program, and the brand's own page explicitly states 'uncapped earning potential', so the cap is verified uncapped.
reasons.contact_access: A published email (hello@getsabaidee.com) appears directly in the program page's FAQ.
reasons.opportunity_availability: The program is invite-only and approval-based, which limits open availability despite the public enrollment form.
reasons.credibility: Organic hemp sourcing and public lab tests are claimed on the brand's own page; a smaller, single-category brand than the largest CBD names.

name: Primal Harvest
description: Primal Harvest is a direct-to-consumer supplement brand selling collagen, greens powders, probiotics, turmeric and other everyday wellness formulas through its own store.

evidence.summary: Primal Harvest's own Partner Program page states that through the Shopify Collabs dashboard affiliates receive a discount code and trackable link and earn '30% on new customers, 15% on returning'. The page also lists TikTok Shop as an alternative sign-up route, but the Collabs route is a brand-portal program in its own right. No cap statement is published, so the cap is unknown.
The brand's Collabs page recruits influencers, reviewers, comparison sites and bloggers, and promises complimentary Primal Harvest products plus commission on purchases through each partner's link.

opportunity.title: Primal Harvest Partner Program via Shopify Collabs - 30% on new customers, 15% on returning

reasons.niche_fit: A broad everyday-supplement range (collagen, greens, probiotics) gives health and wellness creators many routine-based content angles.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand runs a dedicated partner program and a Collabs page aimed at influencers, reviewers and bloggers, with gifted product.
reasons.compensation: 30% on new customers and 15% on returning customers, published on the brand's own partner page; the 30% new-customer rate is recorded. No cap statement is published, so the cap is unknown, not uncapped.
reasons.contact_access: No public affiliate email is published; contact runs through the Shopify Collabs dashboard.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open through Shopify Collabs from the brand's own partner page.
reasons.credibility: An established DTC supplement brand with a full public store and partner infrastructure.

name: ZBiotics
description: ZBiotics is a direct-to-consumer biotech company selling genetically engineered probiotic drinks - a Pre-Alcohol Probiotic Drink designed to break down a toxic alcohol byproduct, and a Sugar-to-Fiber Probiotic Drink Mix for microbiome health.

evidence.summary: ZBiotics' own affiliate page invites anyone who uses the product to apply; affiliates receive complimentary product to start creating content, a customised discount code and URL, and earn commission on every new customer purchase. No rate or cap statement is published on the page.

LinkClicky lists the ZBiotics program at 10% per sale (listing dated March 2024). The brand's live registration now runs on UpPromote, whose published terms do not state a rate, so the 10% directory figure is recorded as publicly reported.

A Tremendous case study of the ZBiotics program states it 'scaled from a handful of influencers and affiliates to over 1000' before the program moved to Superfiliate in 2024 - absolute-terms evidence that creator saturation is high, not low.
ZBiotics' affiliate terms on its own UpPromote registration page direct program contact to affiliates@zbiotics.com and state commissions are paid only to affiliates based in the United States.

opportunity.title: ZBiotics affiliate program - 10% per sale per directory listing; program reported at over 1,000 affiliates

reasons.niche_fit: A genuinely novel probiotic with a clear before/after story gives health creators a distinctive, demonstrable product.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Influencers and affiliates are the brand's core growth channel - a vendor case study documents the program scaling past 1,000 participants, and affiliates receive free product for content.
reasons.compensation: 10% per sale per the LinkClicky directory listing; the brand does not publish a current rate or any cap statement, so the cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: A named affiliate inbox (affiliates@zbiotics.com) is published in the program's own terms.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open on the brand's site, restricted to US-based affiliates.
reasons.credibility: A science-led biotech brand with named team members and third-party case-study coverage of its program.

name: YO Home Sperm Test
description: The YO Home Sperm Test is an FDA-cleared, smartphone-based at-home sperm test developed by Medical Electronic Systems (MES); it measures motile sperm concentration, shows a live sperm video, and is aligned to WHO 6th Edition standards.

evidence.summary: YO's own affiliates page publishes its commission structure: affiliates choose to keep the full 25% commission, or offer followers a 10% discount and keep 15%, or offer a 15% discount and keep 10%. The full-keep 25% rate is recorded. No cap statement is published, so the cap is unknown.

The page offers affiliates a full marketing content pack - professional product images, lifestyle photography, video demos, and pre-written social captions and hashtags - plus a real-time affiliate dashboard and seasonal campaigns.
The page states YO is the world's first FDA-cleared smartphone-based sperm test with 97% accuracy, developed by MES, described as a global leader with 25+ years in automated semen analysis.

opportunity.title: YO Home Sperm Test affiliate program - keep the full 25% commission, or trade rate for a follower discount

reasons.niche_fit: At-home fertility testing is a growing, underserved niche for men's-health and family-planning creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand supplies a ready-made content pack with video demos and pre-written captions, and runs seasonal campaigns for affiliates.
reasons.compensation: A published 25% commission when the affiliate keeps the full rate; no cap statement is published, so the cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: No public affiliate email is published; contact is via the sign-up form on the affiliates page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open sign-up through the affiliate form on the brand's own page.
reasons.credibility: FDA clearance, WHO 6th Edition alignment and a 25+ year diagnostics parent company are stated on the brand's own page.

name: Natural Shilajit
description: Natural Shilajit, operated by Healthy Nutrition Group LLC, sells shilajit resin and related fulvic-acid supplements direct to consumers, positioning on laboratory authentication of its raw material.

evidence.summary: The program's official terms, published on its Refersion portal, state: 'The standard commission rate is 25% of eligible product revenue attributed to the affiliate', with a standard 45-day attribution window. The terms publish no earnings-cap statement, so the cap is recorded as unknown.
The terms name the operator as Healthy Nutrition Group LLC and set detailed affiliate content rules, including FTC disclosure and a prohibition on disease claims.

opportunity.title: Natural Shilajit affiliate program via Refersion - 25% standard commission per the published program terms

reasons.niche_fit: Shilajit is a trending supplement ingredient with strong interest among men's-health and biohacking creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program terms directly govern creator content - disclosure, claims and lab-data rules - showing an active affiliate channel, though no content pack is published.
reasons.compensation: A 25% standard commission published in the program's own terms; no cap statement is published, so the cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: No public affiliate email is published in the terms; contact runs through the Refersion portal.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open on Refersion, subject to program approval.
reasons.credibility: A named operating LLC and unusually detailed compliance terms, including laboratory-authentication requirements for content.

name: Intimina
description: Intimina is a Swedish brand dedicated exclusively to women's intimate health - menstrual cups, smart Kegel exercisers and pelvic-health products - sold worldwide through its own store.

evidence.summary: Intimina's own affiliates page offers '8-10% commission paid on all affiliate sales', affiliate-only coupon codes, and product discounts or samples for reviews, aimed at websites, blogs and YouTube channels. The 8% floor of the published range is recorded. No cap statement is published, so the cap is unknown.
The page publishes affiliates@intimina.com for affiliate questions.
The page describes Intimina as a Swedish brand offering a complete range dedicated to women's intimate health, from menstrual cups to the world's first smart Kegel exerciser.

opportunity.title: Intimina affiliate program - 8-10% commission paid on all affiliate sales

reasons.niche_fit: Women's intimate health is a loyal, content-rich niche, though narrower than general wellness.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program page explicitly recruits websites, blogs and YouTube channels and offers review samples.
reasons.compensation: A published 8-10% commission range; the 8% floor is recorded. No cap statement is published, so the cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: A named affiliate inbox (affiliates@intimina.com) is published on the program page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open sign-up from the brand's own affiliates page.
reasons.credibility: A long-established Swedish brand with a full product range and global store.

evidence.summary: Mycroboost's Awin merchant profile offers 'a commission of 20% per sale' when a visitor buys within 90 days of clicking, with banners, text links, data feeds and a dedicated affiliate marketing manager. No cap statement is published, so the cap is unknown.

opportunity.title: Mycroboost affiliate program via Awin - 20% per sale, 90-day cookie

reasons.ugc_evidence: The Awin profile offers banners, data feeds and widgets and a monthly promotional newsletter for partners.

reasons.contact_access: A dedicated affiliate marketing manager is advertised on the profile, though no direct email is published.

name: Wild Alaskan Company
description: Wild Alaskan Company is a subscription service delivering wild-caught, sustainably sourced Alaskan seafood to members across the United States, founded by a third-generation commercial fisherman.

evidence.summary: Wild Alaskan Company's Awin merchant profile lists a '$30 Default Commission Rate' with a 30-day cookie period - a flat $30 bounty per subscription rather than a percentage of sale, so commission_rate is null and the flat bounty is recorded here. No cap statement is published, so the cap is unknown.
An older affiliate review described a $75 flat fee per new subscriber; the current Awin profile's $30 default supersedes it, and the change is documented rather than averaged.
The Awin profile describes the company's mission to accelerate the transition to sustainable food systems and its founding by Arron Kallenberg, the son and grandson of commercial fishermen.

opportunity.title: Wild Alaskan Company affiliate program via Awin - flat $30 default commission per new subscription

reasons.niche_fit: Premium seafood subscription boxes are a strong fit for food, cooking and sustainability creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program runs through Awin with standard creative support; the brand's story-driven sourcing suits unboxing and recipe content.
reasons.compensation: A flat $30 bounty per new subscription on boxes priced well above that; recorded as a flat bounty, not a percentage. No cap statement is published, so the cap is unknown.
reasons.contact_access: No public affiliate email is published; contact runs through Awin.
reasons.credibility: A well-known national subscription brand with a published sustainability mission and founder story.

name: Genexa
description: Genexa makes clean over-the-counter medicine - the same active ingredients as leading brands, without artificial dyes, preservatives, sweeteners or common allergens - across pain and fever, cold and flu, allergy, digestion and sleep, for infants, kids and adults. The company is a Certified B Corp.

evidence.summary: Genexa's own Instagram post (November 2025) invites anyone to join its free affiliate program, stating 'It's through Levanta and it's free to join', with sign-up via the link in the brand's bio.

Lasso lists Genexa at 'up to 26.25%' - a ceiling, not a base rate - while Shopper lists a 5-10% payout range. The published figures conflict, so commission_rate is null and the conflict is documented here. No cap statement is published, so the cap is unknown.

opportunity.title: Genexa affiliate program via Levanta - free to join per the brand's own Instagram announcement

reasons.niche_fit: Clean medicine for kids and families is a strong fit for parenting and family-health creators.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand actively recruits everyday recommenders on its own Instagram, framing the program around people already sharing the products.
reasons.compensation: No settled rate could be verified - directory figures conflict (up to 26.25% vs 5-10%) - so the rate is null and compensation scores low until the program publishes terms.
reasons.contact_access: No public affiliate email is published; joining runs through Levanta via the brand's bio link.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free and open to join per the brand's own announcement.
reasons.credibility: Certified B Corp status and clean-label positioning are published by the brand and its directory listings.
